name: Kreativ Report Broken Link
description: Let visitors flag broken links and manage their reports in WordPress.
cardUse: Collect visitor reports, track fixes, and export a CSV.
metaDescription: Let visitors report broken links, manage reports in WordPress, and export a CSV. This plugin does not automatically scan your site.

detailItems.title: Visitor reports, not an automatic scanner
detailItems.body: Adds a report button to enabled post types so visitors can flag a page with broken links. It does not crawl or automatically check URLs.

detailItems.title: Actionable reporting
detailItems.body: Exports clear reports for cleanup sessions so teams can resolve link debt quickly.

detailItems.title: Keep track of fixes
detailItems.body: Resolve, ignore, or reopen reports from the WordPress dashboard, with optional email notifications.

homepageScreenshot.alt: Kreativ Report Broken Link reports dashboard with status filters and resolve and ignore actions
homepageScreenshot.caption: Visitor reports, ready to review in WordPress.

items.title: Site owners doing regular cleanup
items.body: This plugin is built for WordPress teams that need a practical way to find broken internal and external links before they turn into visible trust issues.

items.title: Agencies maintaining multiple sites
items.body: Use visitor feedback as one part of a maintenance routine. Pair it with a separate scanner when you need automatic link checks.

items.title: Receive a report, check the page, then resolve it
items.body: Review visitor-submitted reports in the dashboard, inspect the affected page, repair its links, and mark the report resolved. Export a CSV when you need to share the work.

changelog.label: Status refresh
changelog.body: Plugin page copy and public metadata were refreshed to align with the current Kreativ WP release and maintenance messaging.

changelog.label: Release note link added
changelog.body: The plugin page now links directly to a dedicated update post instead of sending visitors to the generic news index.
